body:
Worker 01 continuation recovered concrete source quantities and preparation context for the frozen all-unmatched shard. These observations refine the existing source-backed corpus-repair backlog; they are not automatic corrections and do not claim the same bytes remain on current CultureMech main. Before applying, compare each exact current recipe against the frozen selector and original source.

| Finding | Exact scope and observed difference | Follow-up |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NBRC 1257 nested preparation denominators | Cases 11 and 112, CultureMech:007467 / `NBRC_1261.yaml`, `solutions/2/composition/0` and `solutions/3/composition/0`: source bicarbonate lists 8.4 g NaHCO3 plus 100 mL water; sulfide lists 12 g Na2S·9H2O plus 50 mL water. Neither added-water amount is a measured final stock volume. Frozen values are 8.4 and 12 `G_PER_L`, while preparation-water rows retain 100/50 mL. | Repair the preparation basis and preserve CO2/N2 handling. Receiving doses are 30 mL bicarbonate and **1.5 mL sulfide**; do not substitute preparation volume for dose. |
| Source volume represented as mass | Root cases 4, 7, 8, 22, 23, 29, 31, 36, 40, 49, 83 and 158 include MDS salt water, filtered tomato juice, resazurin/phenol-red stocks, concentrated HCl, 1 M NH4Cl, MQ water preparations. | Use each bound original amount/unit and stock level from the decisions; do not use density guesses or reinterpret every number as final g/L. The root source ledger contains exact per-occurrence selectors and distinct preparation versus receiving amounts. |
| Unresolved source quantity notation | Case 24, EZMix-N-Z-amine A in TOGO M2816 / CultureMech:009364, `ingredients/5`: the source value is 0.1 with unit `(w/v)`, while the frozen occurrence is 0.1 `G_PER_L`. This is a percentage/denominator clarification, not an established volume-to-mass substitution. | Preserve the original notation and obtain the intended quantity basis before converting it to g/L. The likely original article full text was not successfully retrieved; the independently supported product identity does not resolve this historical dose. |
| Mass prefix and stock level | Case 9, TOGO M3174: the source stock has 1 mg anhydrous Na2SeO3, whereas the frozen quantity is 1 `G_PER_L`. | Restore the source mass and stock denominator; retain the independently supported dry reagent identity. |
| JCM water L-to-mL loss | Frozen JCM 1468, 1419, 1365, 1354, 1430 and 1431 encode source 1.0 L water as 1.0 `ML_PER_L`. | Confirm current recipe bytes, then retain the original litre preparation rather than treating it as one millilitre per litre. |
| Competing frozen/current recipe versions | Frozen JCM 1422 narrative uses 940 mL water, 50 mL bicarbonate and SL10/1303 context; current JCM 1422 has 955 mL, 30 mL bicarbonate and Wolfe 265. Frozen JCM 1188 describes inheritance from 1187, while current JCM 1188 gives its own recipe and directly references Se/W 852. | Preserve both versions and provenance. Establish the intended version before replacement; the current direct source reference must not be described as verified inheritance. |

This combines the quantity repair scope of [CultureMech #150](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/issues/150) and the unit substitution scope of [CultureMech #408](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/issues/408). [CultureMech #344](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/issues/344) is the narrower queue for genuinely missing addition-volume evidence; the recovered quantities above are not new missing-volume holds.

Evidence: [named_stocks/issues-for-root.json](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/named_stocks/issues-for-root.json), [concentration_stocks/findings-for-root.json](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/concentration_stocks/findings-for-root.json), [root_substances/decisions.fragment.json](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/root_substances/decisions.fragment.json). Full frozen occurrences and original source captures are linked by the case/evidence ledgers. Known stock formulations already represented in CultureMech remain usable source contexts. Scientifically settled MIM identities are receiving concrete registry proposals; integration work alone is not a scientific gap. All maintained source files remain unchanged in this research artifact.

Additional source-shape findings for this same repair round:

- Case 18: JCM 857 and 1281 replace the parent 731 betaine with sodium lactate and glucose, respectively. Frozen inherited betaine in those variants is unsupported. JCM 770 / solution 4712 uses 10 mL of 1 M betaine; its frozen 200% v/v is invalid.
- Case 37: DSMZ 863 / solution 5663 uses 5 mL of 15% TiCl3 solution, Merck 808307, whereas JCM 1331 states 0.75 g TiCl3. Preserve the commercial stock and its dose rather than replacing its identity with a dry-equivalent mass.
- Case 74: CCAP UCM has 0.093 g As2O3 per 100 mL in alkaline primary stock 2; 0.1 mL/L of that stock enters the trace stock, where the listed concentration is 0.000093 g/L. These are different preparation levels. The related existing tracker is [CultureMech #283](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/issues/283).
- Case 45 contextual ingredient in frozen `pe.yaml`: sodium phosphate dodecahydrate is paired with CHEBI:86416, a phosphocholine lipid term. Preserve the primary Na2HPO4·12H2O identity and check current source bytes before repairing this contextual grounding. Historical [CultureMech #276](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/issues/276) is closed and does not establish this exact current correction.

Exact root groups and selectors: [root findings](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/root_substances/findings-for-root.json).

Case 14 also needs distinct quantity bases: TOGO M3118 lists 94 mg Na2SeO4·5H2O and 1000 mL added water; it does not establish a final 94 mg/L concentration. Frolov’s thesis independently heads its table in mg/L and gives unhydrated Na2SeO4 at 94 mg/L, with a 1 mL/L receiving-medium dose. Preserve that source/version distinction and the unresolved hydration conflict. [Quantity correction](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/root_substances/case14-quantity-correction-v7.json).

Worker 02 of the authorized all-unmatched source review adds source-bound observations to this existing unit/preparation backlog and #150. These observations concern the frozen campaign recipes; they are not a claim that every listed quantity remains unchanged on current main, and they approve no automatic dose conversion.

| Frozen source context | Primary-source observation | Required follow-up |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TOGO M1084 / M357, 8% w/v Na2CO3 | JCM 1023 / 363 specify a 2.5 mL addition, while both frozen occurrences store 2.5 G_PER_L. | Preserve solution strength and liquid addition separately. |
| TOGO M2277, cobalt chloride hexahydrate | The named source component is 190 mg in Solution 2 / SL12; frozen value is 190 G_PER_L. | Retain the stock preparation and resolve the I/l spelling from the named component. |
| TOGO M2649, FeSO4·7H2O solution | Pinned TOGO gives 10 mL/L of 0.2% w/v stock; frozen value is 10 G_PER_L. Current DSMZ 503 instead describes 0.1% stock. | Preserve source version and liquid dose; do not silently overwrite the older strength. |
| TOGO M2231, MgSO4·7H2O (6 g/L) | Source gives 5 mL of the stock; frozen value is 5 G_PER_L. | Separate stock strength from dose. |
| TOGO M3155, FeSO4·7H2O | Source has 0.05 g/L direct plus 10 mL/L of a trace stock containing 0.8 g/L; frozen value sums 0.05 + 0.8 as 0.85 G_PER_L. | Restore preparation levels; stock composition must not be summed directly into final medium. |
| TOGO M997 / M1016, Mohr salt | JCM 950 / 966 specify 2.0 mg; both frozen occurrences store 2 G_PER_L. | Restore the source mass and recipe basis. Identity alias support does not approve the frozen quantity. |
| TOGO M2509 / NIES SOT, MnSO4·5H2O | Original footnote substitutes 217 mg pentahydrate for 250 mg heptahydrate. TOGO places 217 mg in a 100 mL A5 stock, with a 0.1 mL dose; frozen value is 217 G_PER_L. | Preserve the footnote and stock hierarchy; do not interpret the stock mass as final g/L. |
| TOGO M2790, 1 M MgSO4 | Source gives 200 µL of 1 M stock in its 100 mL recipe basis; frozen value is 200 G_PER_L. | Represent liquid addition separately; no solid hydrate can be inferred. |
| TOGO M1094 trace solution | Chrome alum 0.5 mg, Mohr salt 78.4 mg and SrSO4 0.92 mg appear with the same numeric values as G_PER_L in frozen flattened occurrences. | Restore each mass and preparation level. MediaDive solution 5083 independently gives SrSO4 0.00092 g/L within the trace solution. |
| TOGO M940 and M3174 | Mohr salt 784 mg in M940 and anhydrous alum 10 mg in M3174 appear as 784 and 10 G_PER_L in frozen occurrences. | Retain acidic-stock preparation / Wolfe mineral elixir context and original units. |

Primary evidence includes [JCM 950](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=950), [JCM 966](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=966), [NIES SOT](https://mcc.nbrp.jp/medium/ja/sot.pdf), [DSMZ 503](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium503.pdf), and the corresponding TOGO API captures. Complete occurrence IDs, exact file/field selectors, original recipe hashes, primary capture hashes and per-case reasoning are retained in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/b/source-defect-inventory.json` and in `a/decisions.json`, `a/evidence.json` and their linked frozen case/recipe captures. The concise A quantity inventory is `a/review-revisions/source-unit-findings.json`. These artifacts are on the assigned `review/all-unmatched-w02-source-review-20261107` branch. B's inventory received separate skeptical review in `c/independent-review-b-source-defects.json`; A's quantities were challenged and confirmed by B in `b/review-a/`.

The worker prepared isolated MIM proposals only. No maintained CultureMech or MIM source, concentration, mapping export, or publication selector was changed. Source-form and source-version holds remain. Before applying a correction, compare the exact current recipe to the frozen selector and reconstruct the complete source preparation hierarchy.
